name: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited
summary: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes natural rubber products in Thailand, China, the United States, Japan, Korea, India, Germany, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Natural Rubber Products, Gloves, and Other Businesses. The company manufactures, sells, and trades in ribbed smoked sheets, concentrated latex, and block rubbers, as well as special grade and air dried sheets; manufactures and sells powdered, powder-free, and nitrile latex gloves; and offers finished products, including examination gloves and high-pressure, compact, and mining hydraulic hoses, as well as industrial and water jet washing …
